title: Optimized protocol for whole-mount RNA fluorescent in situ hybridization using oxidation-mediated autofluorescence reduction on mouse embryos
protocol: Euthanize mice and collect embryos according to institutional ethical committee guidelines.
Dissect and wash embryos in ice-cold PBS buffer to remove blood.
Transfer freshly dissected embryos to a glass vial.
Add minimally 5 mL of ice-cold 4% PFA in 1x PBS (pH 7.4).
Place the glass vial on a rotating or gently rocking platform for 12–16 h at 4°C to fix the embryos.
Remove the fixative solution carefully.
Wash with 5 mL 1x PBS minimally 3 times for 5 min.
Wash 2 times 5 min in PBST.
Remove PBST and dehydrate the embryos in the Methanol (MeOH) dehydration series for 10 min each at room temperature on a rocking platform.
Using 5 mL per tube for each step: Transfer to 25% MeOH / 75% PBST.
Transfer to 50% MeOH / 50% PBST.
Work under a laminar flow chemical hood and follow institutional safety guidelines for handling hazardous substances like PFA and methanol.
Remove embryos from 100% Methanol storage and rehydrate them in the following series: 75% MeOH / 25% PBST, 50% MeOH / 50% PBST, 25% MeOH / 75% PBST, and 100% PBST.
Dissect embryonic tissues such as limb buds from rehydrated embryos if necessary.
Transfer dissected tissue in PBST into individual wells of a 24-well tissue culture plate.
Wash the tissue two times for 5 min each with PBS.
Immerse limb buds in bleaching solution containing hydrogen peroxide and sodium hydroxide.
Expose limb buds to LED spotlight source or LED light plates (20000 lumen) for photochemical bleaching.
Prepare fresh bleaching solution before use.
Remove PBS from the plate and add 1 mL Bleaching Solution.
Expose the plate to intense LED light for 45 min.
Maintain an approximately 2 cm–3 cm distance between the plate and light source to avoid sample heating.
Remove the Bleaching Solution after exposure.
Wash embryos twice with 1 mL PBS for 5 min at room temperature (24°C) on a rocking platform (20 oscillations/min).
Carefully remove the Bleaching Solution.
Wash with PBS to avoid damaging the tissue.
Add 1 mL of freshly prepared Bleaching Solution.
Expose the microwell plate to LED light for 45 min.
Remove the Bleaching Solution and wash limb buds/tissue samples at least three times with 1 mL PBST for 10 min each at room temperature on a rocking platform.
Check the limb buds/tissue samples under the microscope for any remaining bubbles.
If bubbles persist, wash the samples longer in PBST with gentle shaking.
Transfer limb buds in 1 mL PBST to a clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Carefully remove all PBST from the tube.
Replace with 1 mL Detergent Solution and incubate for 2 h at 37°C on a shaker at 300 rpm.
Remove the Detergent Solution after incubation.
Wash limb buds twice with 1 mL PBST for 5 min at room temperature (24°C).
Remove the PBST from limb buds.
Equilibrate the limb buds in 100 μL of Probe Hybridization buffer for 10 min at 24°C on a shaker at 300 rpm.
Discard the Probe Hybridization buffer.
Replace with 200 μL of pre-warmed (37°C) Probe Hybridization buffer and incubate for 1 h or longer at 37°C, 300 rpm.
Remove the pre-hybridization solution from limb buds.
Replace it with prepared probe mixes (100 μL per tube).
Incubate for 12–16 h at 37°C on a shaking platform set to 300 rpm at 37°C.
Remove the probe mixes from limb buds.
Add 200 μL of pre-warmed Probe Wash buffer.
Perform four washes with pre-warmed Probe Wash buffer of 20 min each at 37°C with shaking at 300 rpm.
Recover and store the used probe mixes at -20°C for reuse.
Remove Probe Wash buffer.
Wash three times with 1 mL 5x SSCT (pH 7.4) for 20 min per wash at room temperature (24°C).
Remove the 5x SSCT.
Add 200 μL of pre-equilibrated Amplification buffer for 5 min at 24°C.
Replace the Amplification buffer with 200 μL of fresh pre-equilibrated Amplification buffer.
Pre-amplify limb bud samples for at least 1 h or more at 24°C.
Heat H1 and H2 separately in separate tubes for 90 s at 95°C.
Let them cool down to room temperature (24°C) for 30 min in a dark place.
Mix hairpin H1 and H2 in the Amplification buffer.
Per tube containing 4-6 limb buds, use 2 μL of Hairpin H1 and H2 (3 μM stock) per fluorophore in 100 μL Amplification buffer.
Replace the Amplification buffer with 100 μL hairpin mix per tube.
Incubate the limb buds for 12-16 h on a shaker (300 rpm) at 24°C.
Recover the hairpin mixes.
Wash the limb buds three times 5 min with 1 mL 5x SSCT at room temperature (24°C) on a rocking platform (20 oscillations/min).
Transfer the limb bud samples to a clean microcentrifuge tube.
Wash the samples 6 times for 30 min each by incubating them in 1 mL 5x SSCT containing DAPI (diluted 1:1000 from the 1 mg/mL stock) on a rocking platform.
Transfer the limb buds to a new tube protected from light.
Wash 3 times for 5 min with 1 mL 5x SSCT without DAPI.
Transfer limb buds to a new multi-well plate.
Protect the plate from light.
Add freshly prepared Fructose-Glycerol-Clearing solution.
Incubate the tissue at room temperature (24°C) on a rocking platform set to 20 oscillations per minute for 24 hours.
Maintain a pH of 7.4 during the incubation period to ensure fluorophore stability and sample integrity.
Extend clearing time to 48-72 hours if necessary, exchanging the clearing solution every 24 hours with freshly prepared Fructose-Glycerol-Clearing solution.
Choose an iSpacer based on the sample thickness and stick it onto a glass microscope slide.
Place the cleared sample in the middle of a drop of Fructose-Glycerol-Clearing solution on the slide.
Carefully place a coverslip over the sample, avoiding bubble formation.
Use the DAPI channel to visualize and orient the sample for confocal imaging.
Let the samples settle for a few hours before imaging.
Image the samples using a confocal microscope with the Z-stack scanning function for 3D imaging.
Dissolve low-melting-point agarose in 10 mM Tris pH 7.4 to make 1% or 2% agarose.
Cool the agarose solution to 40°C on a heat block with a magnetic stirrer.
Let the cooled agarose stand until microbubbles disappear from the solution.
Pour the bubble-free agarose into a Tissue-Tek cryomold and allow it to cool.
Transfer a limb bud sample using a plastic pipette.
Orient the sample using a pipet tip.
Measure the refractive index using a refractometer before use.
Adjust the refractive index of the Fructose-Glycerol-Clearing solution to 1.45 by adding 10 mM Tris (pH 7.4).
Add 1 mL of the adjusted Fructose-Glycerol-Clearing solution to the agarose-embedded sample tube.
Gently shake on a rocking platform at 20 oscillations/min for 24 h at room temperature in the dark.
Mount agarose-embedded samples onto the metal plunger and then place them into a clearing chamber filled with Fructose-Glycerol-Clearing solution.
Adjust illumination air lenses for refractive index of 1.45.
Use detection objective adjusted to the refractive index for fluorescence detection.
Perform manual alignment of light sheet using 561 nm laser.
Acquire Z-stacks using an optimal step size of 3.77 μm.
Align and fuse acquired images with Fiji and BigStitcher plugin.
Convert results into an IMARIS file for 3D volume reconstruction.
Fix embryos in 4% PFA before dehydration for immunofluorescence.
Store fixed embryos in PBS prior to dehydration for immunofluorescence analysis.
Perform whole-mount immunofluorescence analysis following fixation and photochemical bleaching using an immunohistochemistry protocol without antigen retrieval.
Permeabilize photochemically bleached samples three times for 10 minutes in 0.4% Triton X-100 in PBS at room temperature (24°C).
Remove 0.4% Triton X-100 in PBS from the samples.
Pre-block the samples with blocking solution for at least 45 minutes at room temperature (24°C).
Incubate the samples with primary antibody diluted in blocking solution for 16–20 hours at 4°C.
Remove the primary antibody solution after incubation.
Wash the samples six times for 30 minutes each in 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS (pH 7.4) at room temperature (24°C).
Determine the optimal primary antibody dilution by titration.
Centrifuge the diluted primary antibody at 1500 g for 10 minutes and transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube.
Add secondary antibody in 0.4% Triton X-100 in PBS, 1% BSA, and 10% serum with DAPI (1:1000 dilution).
Incubate samples for 16–20 hours at 4°C in the dark.
Wash samples with 1 mL of 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS (pH 7.4) for 3 hours at room temperature, changing the solution every 30 minutes.
